_comment: A /help command in a PRIVATE chat. Telegram rejects getChatAdministrators for private chats (ok=false), so the router must NOT call it: it resolves the caller locally and replies with sendMessage. The getChatAdministrators fault is a tripwire: if the router calls it, the test's 'no such call' assertion fails.

body.description: Bad Request: chat member list is not available for private chats
